about.title: We make clean effortless.
about.subtitle: Max Housekeeping Service is on a mission to make professional, reliable cleaning accessible to every home and business in India.
about.storyHeading: Built on trust, powered by people.
storyParagraphs: We started Max Housekeeping Service with a simple belief — that a clean space changes how you feel. What began as a dedicated team has grown into a network of trained, background-verified professionals serving thousands of homes and offices across Western Uttar Pradesh.
Every booking is backed by transparent pricing, eco-safe products and a 100% satisfaction guarantee. No surprises, no shortcuts — just consistently spotless results.
